title: Can a small push lift a bigger load? Hydraulic syringes #Shorts
description:
Two connected syringes reveal Pascal’s principle. Ideal area ratio 4:1: 10 N produces 40 N, while 80 mm of input travel gives 20 mm at the larger piston. Work remains 0.8 J. Quasi-static, air-free incompressible-fluid model; friction, leakage, piston weight and hydrostatic head differences are omitted. This is a calculated kinematic visualization, not a CFD simulation. Cutaway barrels; flow cues are schematic.
